---
title: "The ‘Lehman Moment’ that Wasn’t: Marking the Wrong Anniversary"
date: "2018-09-12"
categories: ["Financial Markets"]
---

My [reflection](http://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-09-12/lehman-brothers-collapse-the-moment-that-wasnt/10222638) on the 10th anniversary of the failure of Lehman argues that we are focused on the wrong anniversary. The failure of the Congressionally-mandated GSEs one week before should be the exemplar of the crisis.
